about: PreventionWeb extreme-heat hub, Phase 0 catalogue. Built on 13 November 2026 from web search results restricted to preventionweb.net and from the site's open RSS feed, because PreventionWeb's pages answer automated requests with a Cloudflare managed challenge (403). Titles and addresses come from the search index and the feed, not from reading the pages. publisher_hint is what a search summary named, unverified; original_url is filled only after the original publisher's page is found and checked. Nothing here is published; each item is verified at its original publisher through verify-sources.yml before any page change rests on it.

access.pages: 403 Cloudflare managed challenge for automated requests (hub, knowledge base, terms of use, sitemap, API)
access.rss: https://www.preventionweb.net/rss.xml is open: the 40 newest items across all hazards, no topic filter
access.terms_of_use: not readable automatically; links and our own short summaries only until read
